annotations.title: Set how often a warning mail arrives

description:
Set how often a warning mail arrives

Sets how often one warning mail may arrive, as in the notification settings of the dashboard: `event` every time, `daily` or `weekly` at most once per day or week, `off` never. `category` must be one that `get_warning_mail_settings` lists for your account, otherwise 400. Applies from the next warning on. Owner only, a team member gets 403.
